evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Prompt compressors and retrievers offer solutions to this problem, but patching an issue needs two things at once: the files that must change, and their code exactly as written, since the model must reproduce the lines it edits.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Our analysis shows the defects of the baseline methods: retrievers often miss the files to edit, and compressors keep them but alter their text, so fewer patches apply.
